beats.say: Over a hundred million people live in Egypt, but almost all of them live on a thin green line.
beats.title: EGYPT IS 95% EMPTY

beats.say: About ninety five percent of Egyptians live within twenty kilometers of the Nile and its delta.
Cairo, Alexandria, Luxor, Aswan. Every big city sits on the river.
The rest is the Sahara. Less than one centimeter of rain a year in much of it.
The Nile flows north for more than six thousand kilometers, from deep in Africa, and Egypt is the last country it reaches.
No river, no Egypt. Follow for more.
beats.title: NO RIVER. NO EGYPT.
